title: SproutPlus App Mockup Design
description: A conceptual mobile application design for frictionless surplus food redistribution, connecting donors with receivers to reduce waste and build community impact.
summary: A concept app for redirecting surplus food to people who need it — donors post extra food, receivers claim it nearby. I designed the full flow: dual onboarding, impact tracking, hub discovery, and category browsing. A warm green identity keeps the mission front and center.
outcome: A dignity-first concept for zero food waste
highlights: Dual onboarding for donors and receivers
Impact tracking: CO₂ saved, meals provided
Hub discovery + category browsing in one flow
